title: Offer of Employment
key_sentences: We are delighted to offer you the position of Harbour Operations Planner with Harbourlight Marine Services.
This letter sets out the main terms of your employment.
The offer is conditional on the satisfactory completion of the checks listed below.
Please sign and return the enclosed copy of this letter by 18 December 2026.
We look forward to welcoming you to the team in January.

list_items.text: - 25 days of annual leave plus public holidays.
- Free parking at the Pier Road site.
- Subsidised canteen and a cycle-to-work scheme.
1. Satisfactory references from two previous employers.
2. Proof of the right to work in the United Kingdom, to be shown on your first day, which may include:
(a) a passport or national identity document;
(b) a recent utility bill showing your home address.
3. Completion of the medical questionnaire enclosed with this letter.
I accept the offer on the terms above
I would like to discuss the offer first
